dataset_caveat: Single-annotator, correlated synthetic demo fixture. These metrics are exploratory, not human ground truth or broad generalization claims.

supplement.annotation_method: Single-annotator AI-agent visual fixture annotation; exploratory, not human ground truth.

routing.annotation_method: Routing targets follow the declared request-intent rubric; the model sees the image and task text, while the target is withheld until scoring. Single-annotator fixture design, not independent human ground truth.
